## About
Professor Plumb is a plumbing company focused on residential and multi-family housing. We work out of Mesquite, but we don't expect you to come to us. We're in the business of making house calls.
Our goal is simple: fix the problem right so it doesn't creep back up. Before any work starts, you'll understand what's needed and what it will cost.
You'll talk with people like Amber, our office supervisor, and Amanda in dispatch, and you'll meet techs like Blue and Brian at your door. One reviewer mentioned Blue wearing booties in the house and laying drop cloths from the front door to the utility closet.

## Services
- Drain cleaning: Clearing clogged drains, with jetting available when a line needs more than a snake.
- Water heaters: Repair and replacement for both tank and tankless water heaters.
- Gas service: Repair and replacement of gas piping in your home.
- Water lines: Repairs and replacements for the water lines that feed your home.
- Toilets: Fixing running or broken toilets, or replacing them when it's time.
- Faucets: Repairing drippy faucets or putting in a new one.
- Garbage disposals: Help with garbage disposals that are jammed, leaking or done for.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer emergency plumbing service?
A: Yes. We offer emergency service around the clock, every day of the week.

Q: Are your technicians licensed and insured?
A: Yes. We are fully insured, and our staff is made up of licensed and experienced technicians.

Q: Do I need to bring anything to your office?
A: No. We come to you. Our work is done as house calls.
